title: Sacrifices and Offerings
summary: Sacrifices and offerings shaped Israel’s worship by displaying atonement, thanksgiving, consecration, fellowship, and dependence on God.
background: The sacrificial system included different offerings for different purposes. The New Testament presents Christ’s sacrifice as final, complete, and superior to repeated animal offerings.
teachingHelp: Do not treat every sacrifice as identical. Explain the kind of offering, its setting, and how Hebrews points to Christ’s fulfilled sacrifice.
sources: James M. Freeman, Hand-book of Bible Manners and Customs (1874 / early public-domain editions).
Alfred Edersheim, The Temple: Its Ministry and Services as They Were at the Time of Jesus Christ (1881).
International Standard Bible Encyclopedia, original 1915 edition.
